records.title: Beyond Binary Preferences: Graded Preference Optimization for Limb-Motion Captioning
records.reason: The full paper proposes a graded preference objective and benchmark for person/limb-motion video captioning and evaluates three VLM backbones, including Qwen3-8B; it improves GPA 2.02–3.40 points over DPO and lowers weighted hallucination 21.3% on Qwen3-8B. This is task-quality post-training, not an inference-efficiency method; linked Qwen architecture lineage is only indirect, so retain as borderline pending a concrete technical connection.

records.title: Decoding Affective Nuances: Enhancing MLLMs via Hierarchical Emotion Reasoning and Contrastive Discriminative Pruning
records.reason: Tried the arXiv HTML primary page and PDF for arXiv:2609.36782; HTML returned an internal error and PDF was a cache miss. The abstract describes a plausible inference-time visual-token pruning method, but method, benchmark results, and limitations could not be verified from primary full text; retain as borderline.

records.title: Watch-Think-Interact: Bootstrapping Long-Horizon Multi-Turn Streaming Video Reasoning with Reinforcement Learning
records.reason: WTI trains a streaming video model to answer when evidence is sufficient, continue watching, or selectively recall prior intervals using compact timestamped memory. It evaluates streaming QA benchmarks, but its central contribution is response timing and reasoning behavior rather than a measured reduction in inference resources; retain as a weak long-context video-LLM connection.
